title: The Vesper Bell
notes: Cast into the belfry bell: the bell's purpose (bell source, object), plus the hymn around the rim (AC-3: identical copy). The tongue is missing (Long Vespers).

pages.text:
(Around the rim of the great cracked bell, in plain Vesperine capitals:)

Sleep, you who were not born. Sleep, you who fell. The day is rung. The door is kept.

CAST FOR THE ORDER OF THE VESPER BELL. LET THE NOTE GO DOWN.
